items.title: Every open covering of a profinite space is refined by a finite clopen partition
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every open covering of a profinite space admits a refinement which is a finite partition into clopen subsets (author lemma at source lines 4423-4427, label lemma-profinite-refine-open-covering). The proof (source lines 4429-4446) uses that fibres of the projections to the finite quotients form a fundamental system of neighbourhoods, reduces the covering to finitely many such fibres and picks a common stage by directedness (proof lines 4429-4445). The reduction and the common stage are the content. H3.
